banner: ESTIMATE, not measured. SYNTHETIC DEMO: every figure comes from fictional answers and labelled assumptions.
executive_summary: HYPOTHESIS from your own answers: the largest pressure in Copying web orders into the ERP is REPEATED WORK, because the same steps are done by hand every time. Base case: about 6.5 hours a week of capacity could be released IF the self-reported numbers and the labelled assumptions hold. Low to high: 1.5 to 12 hours.
limitations: This is a questionnaire result, not a measurement of your systems. Nothing was connected or scanned.
Free fixes and doing nothing are valid outcomes and are shown with the same weight as any paid route.
Existing-software tips are UNVERIFIED until a person checks the vendor and the version.
No individual staff member is assessed. The seven dimensions describe the work, not the people.

statements: Every input is SELF_REPORTED. Every reduction, adoption and overhead figure is ASSUMED.
Low, base and high are scenario bands, not statistical confidence intervals.
Waiting time is elapsed time. It is shown beside the hours and never added to them.
Capacity freed is not cash saved. Payroll savings need proof that actual costs change.
No implementation cost is known yet, so no return on investment is computed.
Measurement maturity rung for this report: SELF_REPORTED (next rung: INSTRUMENTED BASELINE).
method.worked_example_fictional: 200 tasks a week, 12 min before, 7 min after, adoption 0.80, overhead 100 min: (200*5*0.8-100)/60 = 11.67 hours of capacity a week
